Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
**THE RECORD BREAKER**

FADE IN:

INT. WORLD RECORD OFFICE - DAY

We see a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and camera crews. At the center of it all is 127-year-old JASPER JENKINS, a frail but determined man with a twinkle in his eye. He is escorted to a podium, where a plaque awaits him.

OFFICIAL
Ladies And Gentlemen, It Is Our Pleasure To Present The World Record For Oldest Human To Ever Live, Held By The Incomparable Jasper Jenkins!

Jasper Steps Up To The Microphone, A Beaming Smile On His Face.

JASPER
Thank You, Thank You. I'm Just A Regular Fellow Who's Been Lucky Enough To Make It This Far.

The Crowd Erupts In Applause As Jasper Accepts The Plaque And A Standing Ovation Ensues.

CUT TO:

INT. JASPER'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Jasper Lies In Bed, The Plaque On His Nightstand. He Looks Up At The Ceiling, A Faraway Look In His Eyes.

JASPER (V.O)
I Remember Reading About This Theory Online, Back In The Day. Quantum Immortality. It Said That If You Were Born In A Universe With A Multiverse, And You Were Born In A Universe Where You Didn't Die, Then You Would Live Forever.

Jasper's Voice Becomes More Urgent, More Desperate.

JASPER (V.O)
But What If It's Not Just A Theory? What If It's A Reality? What If I'm Not Just A Record Holder, But A Survivor Of A Multiverse?

Jasper's Eyes Glaze Over As He Becomes Lost In Thought.

JASPER (V.O)
I've Been Living For 127 Years, But What If I've Only Been Living In One Of Many Universes? What If I'm Just A Drop In The Ocean, A Fleeting Moment In The Grand Tapestry Of Time?

Jasper's Voice Cracks As He Breaks Down.

JASPER (V.O)
Oh God, Oh God, Oh God... What If I'm Not Alone? What If There Are Others Out There, Living Forever, Watching Me, Waiting For Me?

Jasper's Body Begins To Shake As He Loses Control.

JASPER (V.O)
I'M NOT ALONE! I'M NOT ALONE! I'M NOT ALONE!

The Camera Zooms Out As Jasper's Body Continues To Shake, His Voice Fading Into The Distance.

FADE TO BLACK.

**THE END**
